title: Epiphany during Jean Houston's mystery school lecture on The Cipher of Genesis
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Epiphany during Jean Houston's mystery school lecture on The Cipher of Genesis, about unspecified at Jean Houston's mystery school, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: somehow as I'm listening to this lecture, I got it. And I had the experience of how it happened, how God created this universe.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of the mind and psychic experience, says he was once at a teacher named Jean Houston's mystery school, a series of teaching sessions, listening to a lecture on The Cipher of Genesis, a book by Carlos Suares about hidden meaning in the Bible's first book. He says that as he listened, something clicked, and he felt he was experiencing how God created the universe. He tells it as a moment of direct insight.
